description:
Check how likely your business is to appear in answers from AI assistants, and learn about AI implementation and training services from Ray Arceneaux, MBA, a Nashville-based consultant.

Start with the AI Visibility Audit: enter a business name, city, and industry (website optional) to receive an estimated Discoverability Score, an Actionability Score, a visibility rating, and two to three prioritized recommendations, including one step you can take today.

With this plugin you can:
- Run an AI Visibility Audit for a business
- Review consulting services, including AI Readiness Sessions, AI implementation, and staff training
- See the four-step Discover, Design, Build, Train engagement process
- Get answers to common questions about cost, timeline, and technical requirements
- Request a consultation, receive a services overview by email, and get a single-use link to schedule a 30-minute Zoom call

Contact details are collected only when you ask to get in touch, and your email address is verified with a one-time code before anything is saved or sent.

Built for small and mid-sized businesses, including real estate brokerages, law firms, medical practices, and local service companies, that want practical help adopting AI tools.

defaultPrompt: Tell me about Ray's background and qualifications.
What is the process for working with Ray?
